## Continuity preflight — required

- [ ] I read `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/governance/PROJECT_CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL.md`, and `docs/governance/PROJECT_STATE_LEDGER.md`.
- [ ] I checked the latest Jalal 5 schedule **and the actual workbook**; I did not use chat memory or an old report as the source of truth.
- [ ] I checked current `main`, relevant GitHub issues/PRs/reviews, and test/check results for the exact candidate SHA.
- [ ] If any source/check was inaccessible, I explicitly marked the affected acceptance item `BLOCKED / UNKNOWN`.

## Work traceability — required

- **Jalal 5 activity ID(s):** 
- **Issue / decision record:** 
- **Work owner / reviewer:** 
- **Decision superseded (if any):** 
- **Changed files / paths:** 
- **Candidate commit SHA:** 
- **Target base branch and SHA:** 

## Scope and acceptance

- **What changed and why:** 
- **Acceptance criteria / Definition of Done:** 
- **Tests or checks run (exact command/link and exact SHA):** 
- **Runtime / integration / user-journey evidence:** 
- **Security, permissions, tenant scope, audit or revision implications:** 
- **Localization / RTL-LTR / Jalali-Gregorian / SEO impacts, if applicable:** 

## Schedule and evidence

- [ ] The linked Jalal 5 activity row and status have been updated when scope/status changed.
- [ ] Any scope, weight, estimate, predecessor, owner-lane or forecast change is reflected in the workbook and the 100.00-point total / dependency QA has been recalculated where applicable.
- [ ] The PR makes no claim of product completion based only on docs, comments, mocks, stale checks, or an open PR.
- [ ] The handoff notes remaining blockers, unknowns, risks, and the next concrete action.

## V1 scope guardrails

- [ ] Website + Desktop + **native Mobile are all required in V1**; I did not apply the superseded Mobile V2 deferral (see [Issue #1486](https://github.com/consttruction-pm/consttruction-pm-platform/issues/1486)).
- [ ] Scheduling, calendars, resource leveling, progress, cost and EVM use the authoritative Shared Domain/Calculation Core; no duplicate client-side calculation engine was added.
- [ ] Where calculation behavior is affected, the relevant source-backed contract and regression/parity evidence are linked.

## Reviewer disposition

- **Status:** DECIDED / PLANNED / IN PROGRESS / BLOCKED / IMPLEMENTED—UNVERIFIED / MERGED—VERIFYING / ACCEPTED / SUPERSEDED
- **Unverified or rejected criteria and why:** 
- **Evidence accepted by reviewer:**
